# Your Child Can Learn a New Language—The Fun Way

A language learning app where kids tap to hear words in 20+ languages, watch fun animations, and take picture quizzes to build real vocabulary—no reading required!

 Perfect for bilingual families, heritage languages, or learning a second language early. Kids learn 5-8 new words per unit in their target language, then unlock the next level. 

 100% Ad-Free Works Offline Safe for Kids 

 iPhone & iPad 

"My daughter has learned 50+ Arabic words in just 3 weeks. She's actually having conversations with her grandmother now!"

— Sarah M., Parent of bilingual child

## Learn 20+ Languages

From Arabic to Japanese, Spanish to Korean—give your child the gift of multilingual fluency

20+ Languages Available Arabic, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more

50+ Learning Units Topics like Animals, Food, Colors, Daily Phrases

300+ Words Per Language Build real conversational vocabulary

2-Way Language Learning Native language + target language audio

## Why Parents Choose Koko Fun for Language Learning

Traditional language apps require reading. Duolingo-style apps aren't built for toddlers. KokoFun is the first language learning app designed specifically for pre-readers.

Designed for ages 2-8 — Pure audio learning means no reading required

Perfect for bilingual families — Keep heritage languages alive or start a second language early

Real language acquisition — Learn words in context, not isolated vocabulary lists

Works like immersion — Kids hear native pronunciation and learn through repetition and play

 Join 20,000+ families raising multilingual children 

Made for Pre-Readers

No typing or reading required. Kids tap colorful buttons, hear clear audio, and learn independently.

20+ Languages Included

Celebration Moments

Finish a unit and unlock delightful Koko videos that reward effort and build confidence.

## How It Works

Kids learn in 4 simple steps—completely independently

 Step 1 Pick a Topic Animals, food, colors—whatever sparks their curiosity

 Step 2 Tap & Listen Clear audio and fun animations for each word

 Step 3 Take the Quiz 3 pictures, 1 answer—no reading required

 Step 4 Celebrate! Unlock rewards and watch Koko's fun videos

 Result: Kids think they're playing. Parents see real vocabulary growth. 

## Start Learning Today—It's Free!

Join 20,000+ families raising multilingual children

What age is KokoFun for?

KokoFun is designed for children aged 2 to 8—especially those who are curious about words but not yet reading independently.

Does my child need to read?

Not at all! Everything is taught through audio and pictures. Your child just taps and listens.

What languages are included?

We include 20+ languages: Arabic, Chinese, English (US/UK), Spanish (Spain/Mexico), French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil/Portugal), Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Filipino, Farsi, Indonesian, Polish, Greek, and more.

Is it safe for my child?

Yes! KokoFun has no ads, no external links, and includes a parent gate to protect settings from curious taps.

Can my child use it independently?

Absolutely. The interface is designed for little fingers and pre-readers. Kids can explore and learn on their own while you track their progress.

Does it work offline?

Yes! All units and audio are downloaded to your device, so KokoFun works perfectly on planes, car rides, or anywhere without internet.

How do quizzes work for non-readers?

Quizzes show 3 pictures. Your child hears a word and taps the matching image—no reading required. If they get it wrong, they can try again with gentle encouragement.

Will I see what my child is learning?

Yes! You can see which units they've completed, their quiz scores, and overall progress—all from the parent section.

What devices does it work on?

KokoFun is available now for iPhone and iPad. An Android version is coming soon!

Is there a free trial?

Yes! Download the app and try the first few units to see if KokoFun is right for your child.

Is this better than traditional flashcards?

KokoFun combines the best of flashcards (repetition, vocabulary focus) with interactive elements kids love—audio, animations, quizzes, and celebrations. Plus, kids can use it independently.
